name: servicenow_mcp
description: ServiceNow tasks for SynergyAI (jobs) and Fluent app deploy

env.name: SN_INSTANCE
env.label: Instance URL, https://<name>.service-now.com (or mock for the built-in fake instance)

env.name: SN_CLIENT_ID
env.label: OAuth client ID (Machine Identity Console, client credentials grant)

env.name: SN_TAG_PREFIX
env.label: Tag prefix of SynergyAI tasks (correlation display)

env.name: SN_ENVIRONMENT
env.label: dev, test or prod (only dev and test allow deploying apps)

env.name: SN_INSTALL_USER
env.label: Deploy: a user that may install apps (dev/test only, optional)

env.name: SN_DEPLOY_TOKEN
env.label: Deploy: token callers send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (optional)
